items.summary: SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP's SAML2 service provider fails to properly verify authentication assertions, letting an unauthenticated attacker impersonate any user, including privileged accounts. Published in SAP's November 2026 Patch Day; patch with SAP Note 3849308.

A memory-corruption flaw in SAP NetWeaver AS ABAP's Internet Communication Manager lets an unauthenticated attacker trigger arbitrary code execution with crafted network traffic. One of four CVSS 10.0 flaws in SAP's November 2026 Patch Day; patch with SAP Note 3778530.

SAP Gateway ships with a default access-control list that grants high privileges, so an external attacker is treated as a trusted internal application server. The vulnerable state is the shipped default, making unhardened installations directly exposed; patch with SAP Note 3798345.

A heap-based buffer overflow in SAP Web Dispatcher allows unauthenticated remote code execution. One of four CVSS 10.0 flaws in SAP's November 2026 Patch Day; internet-facing Web Dispatcher instances should be patched first.

An output-encoding flaw in the FortiManager and FortiAnalyzer JSON RPC API may allow an unauthenticated attacker to execute unauthorised code or commands when the JSON API is enabled. The worst of eight critical Fortinet advisories published November 10; no exploitation reported yet.
